title: Which way does the suspended load move?
description: Resolve the external mesh, rigid hub and takeoff tangent in the front view.
question: Drive A CW in the front view. Find W (vertical travel) at the shown instant.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. External mesh A/B (16/32 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative. The solid key makes B and D rotate together. B negative, D negative. The taut line follows the left tangent of drum D; CW there is up. D negative, W negative. The requested motion is down (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: W is down, while this choice gives stationary. The keyed hub couples the drum to B and the line is taut.

options.label: B
options.explanation: W is down, while this choice gives up. A CCW drum lifts a taut line at its right rim.

options.label: C
options.explanation: W is down, while this choice gives rotates. The drum turns about its axle. The suspended load travels on the straight line.

options.label: D
options.explanation: This tuple matches the derived motions. A CCW drum lowers a taut line at its left rim.
